product_summary: Own website gokuloverseas.com states: 'Gokul Overseas Manufactures And Exporters Of Castor Oil And Castor-Based Derivates'. Launched 1995 as merchant exporter; integrated castor plant since 2006 in KASEZ (Kandla SEZ), Gujarat. Stated capacities: seed crushing 2,50,000; refining 1,50,000; solvent 1,20,000; hydrogenation 55,500; castor oil derivatives 52,500; total 6,28,000 tpa. Product page /product/ lists 12-HYDROXY STEARIC ACID (CAS 106-14-9, EC 203-366-1, grades PHSA and PHSA stearate) — a saturated C18 fatty acid from hydrolysis of hydrogenated castor oil, creamish flakes/powder, mp 47-76 C. Site also references castor oil, hydrogenated castor oil, and applications in lubricants, metalworking fluids, oilfield chemicals, cosmetics, paint additives, food emulsifiers, plasticizers, drilling chemicals, bitumen modifiers, textile chemicals. Registered office: 'Gokul House', Block A, 'Gokul Pratham', Chandkheda, Ahmedabad 382424, Gujarat; info@gokulgroup.com; ISO 9001:2008 claimed.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — started as merchant exporter (1995), now claims own integrated manufacturing in KASEZ since 2006; both roles present in own narrative. Manufacturing claim is self-declared only, not corroborated by any customs line in this review.
comment: HS mapping: 291570 is EXACT — 12-hydroxystearic acid is literally a hydroxystearic acid of heading 2915.70, confirmed by CAS 106-14-9 on the company's own product page. 382319 is PARTIAL/plausible: castor fatty acid / acid-oil streams from the stated solvent and refining capacity fit 3823.19, but no specific 3823 product is itemised on the site. 390799 is WRONG/uncorroborated: no polyester, alkyd or polymer product appears anywhere on the site — the closest link is 'bitumen modifiers' and 'plasticizers' applications, which is an application, not a product; this code looks like a mis-keyed or aspirational line. Missing from the declaration: 151530 (castor oil itself — the company's headline product) and 151620/151800 (hydrogenated castor oil, backed by the stated 55,500 tpa hydrogenation capacity). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: this is an oleochemical / castor-derivatives producer, not a petroleum or petrochemical company; the 'oil' here is vegetable (castor) oil. Trader signs: the company itself says it began as a merchant exporter, and the Ahmedabad address is a corporate office while the plant is in KASEZ Kandla — a two-site structure typical of manufacturer-exporters, not a red flag by itself. Per project rule 3, the 390799 mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained, code corrected to the actual castor-oleochemical range. All product and capacity data above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — sourced only from the company's own website (gokuloverseas.com home page and /product/ page); no customs line, B-L or GST record was examined in this HS-only review, and no shipment factuality is asserted here. Note: web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) and Google returned HTTP 429, so verification relied on direct fetches of the company site plus one Bing result page; no third-party catalogue (IndiaMART) could be opened, so the product list may be incomplete.
